info.text:
A 2025 study: 83% of Black Friday deals weren't special.

Which? tracked 175 products at 8 UK retailers for a year around Black Friday 2024: 83% were the same price or cheaper at least once outside the four-week sale, and none hit their lowest price of the year on Black Friday itself.
In the US, shoppers spent a record $11.8 billion online on Black Friday 2025 (Adobe).
Adobe says Black Friday 2025 was the season's most discounted day: 23.7% off on average, vs 22.2% in 2024.
Example: a $500 TV at 2025's peak TV discount of 24.3% costs $378.50.

Sources: Which? (Nov 2025); Adobe Analytics (Dec 2025, Jan 2026).
News and education, not financial advice.
